title: TCP connection state machine
goal: Show standard TCP establishment and close-state transitions.

rubric.must: CLOSED visibly branches to LISTEN for passive open and SYN_SENT for active open.
The SYN_SENT and SYN_RCVD states visibly reach ESTABLISHED through labelled SYN, SYN-ACK, and ACK transitions.
ESTABLISHED visibly proceeds through FIN_WAIT_1, FIN_WAIT_2, and TIME_WAIT on an active close.
ESTABLISHED visibly reaches CLOSE_WAIT then LAST_ACK before CLOSED on a passive close.
CLOSING and its transition to TIME_WAIT are visibly present.
TIME_WAIT visibly returns to CLOSED after a 2MSL timeout.
